memory_smoke.loss_check: Failed: the trainer wants the last 20 chip losses to average below the first 20

signature: status failed_loss_not_falling: first 20 chip losses mean 26.23, last 20 mean 27.64.
The 35 chips are shuffled, so the two windows hold two different random sets of 20 chips,
each with five or six empty chips at loss 0 and roofs cropped differently each pass.
loss_check_diagnosis.hypothesis: The check compared different chips; on the same chips the 50 steps lowered the loss.

method: Training loss of each of the same 35 TRAIN smoke chips, no augmentation, no gradient, the
same sampled points, with the epoch-4 starting weights and with the weights after the 50
smoke steps. TRAIN chips only; no DEV, holdout or transfer chip.
one_bounded_comparison.success_criterion: mean loss after the 50 steps below the baseline on the same chips
one_bounded_comparison.stop_condition: one measurement; if not lower, no launch

reading: Training lowers the loss under the amended target rule. The failed check is the window
statistic, not the recipe. The first B9 smoke had 17 chips, so each window covered every chip.
decision: The launch gate (launch_building_train.require_smoke) refuses a smoke with this status.
The worker did not change or bypass the gate and did not launch; the lead decides.
